challenge_description.name: Wrist Assured
challenge_description.description: ontestants hold a handle attached to a rope, keeping a bucket filled with 25% of their body weight suspended in the air. As the challenge progresses, the rope unwinds, making the weight harder to hold until only one survivor remains.

challenge_description.name: Bow Diddley
challenge_description.description: Castaways stand on an angled balance beam while balancing a ball on a rounded wooden bow. At regular intervals, they move to narrower sections of the beam, making it harder to keep steady. If the ball falls or the player steps off the beam, they are eliminated, and the last person remaining wins.
